name: SKYECHIP
recent: SkyeChip 与法国 SiPearl 签署谅解备忘录，探讨联合开发基于 Arm Neoverse CSS 的新一代计算平台，并计划在马来西亚申请新的 ARM CSS 授权。公司表示美国新的芯片出口限制不会带来重大影响。最新季度（2026年9月30日止）营收环比增长9.1%，净利环比增长27.2%。
notable: 与法国 SiPearl 签署谅解备忘录，探讨联合开发基于 Arm Neoverse CSS 的新一代计算平台，并计划在马来西亚申请新的 ARM CSS 授权。
公司表示美国新的芯片出口限制不会带来重大影响。
部分普通股受限于 2026 年 11 月 20 日到期的锁定期协议。
risks: 独立非执行主席 Dato' Seri Wong Siew Hai 在 2026 年 10 月至 11 月期间多次在公开市场及闭门期增持公司股份。
earnings: 2026年9月30日止季度营收为 MYR 54.16 million，环比增长9.1%；净利为 MYR 17.71 million，环比增长27.2%；净利率从28.0%升至32.7%。

recent_en: SkyeChip signed an MOU with France's SiPearl to explore joint development of a next-generation compute platform based on Arm Neoverse CSS, and plans to apply for a new ARM CSS license in Malaysia. The company said new US chip export restrictions will not have a material impact. For the latest quarter ended 30 Sep 2026, revenue rose 9.1% QoQ and net profit rose 27.2% QoQ.
notable_en: Signed an MOU with France's SiPearl to explore joint development of a next-generation compute platform based on Arm Neoverse CSS, and plans to apply for a new ARM CSS license in Malaysia.
The company said new US chip export restrictions will not have a material impact.
Certain ordinary shares are subject to a lock-up agreement ending on 20 Nov 2026.
risks_en: Independent Non-Executive Chairman Dato' Seri Wong Siew Hai acquired shares multiple times in the open market and during closed periods between October and November 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 Sep 2026, revenue was MYR 54.16 million, up 9.1% QoQ; net profit was MYR 17.71 million, up 27.2% QoQ; net margin rose from 28.0% to 32.7%.
